notes.title: Two Weeks Since Release – A Look Back & Free DLC Announcement!
notes.notes:
[p]It's been two weeks since the release of [b]Handyman Fantasy[/b], and once again, we’ve received an overwhelming amount of support and feedback from so many players. We’re truly grateful—thank you all so much![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/375f518ddd07d87b035faccd8fb1afcd3ff46dfe.png"][/img][/p][p]Because our previous title received such a warm response, we felt even more pressure during the development of this game. With a strong desire to create something that would surpass our last work, our entire team poured everything we had into this project. Even so, we were incredibly nervous leading up to launch. But seeing everyone’s kind comments and enjoyment of the game has made it all feel worthwhile.[/p][p]We’ve received a ton of feedback—game impressions, reviews, bug reports—and we sincerely appreciate everyone who took the time to share their thoughts. We read every single message carefully, and all of your input will be a huge help as we continue to grow and improve. Once again, thank you from the bottom of our hearts![/p][p][/p][p]And now, we have a few important announcements to share:[/p][h3][b]🌟 We’ve officially started work on a free DLC![/b]
 Development is already underway, and we’re planning to release it as a free update in the near future as a small way to give back to everyone who has supported us. We’re putting a lot of care into this content—please look forward to it![/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45481435/0933a5b24a2df1e7d02d89ddb2ebdce7a84e3e78.png"][/img][/p][h3]🛠 [b]A DLsite version is also coming soon, along with a playable demo![/b]
 In response to players who prefer platforms outside of Steam, we're working hard to bring the game to DLsite. The store page and demo will be launching in the near future, so please stay tuned![/h3][p][/p][p]We’ll continue doing our best to make sure your experience in the world of [b]Handyman Fantasy[/b] is as enjoyable as possible. Once again, thank you to all our amazing players![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update Notes - 06/20/2025
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]Thank you all for your continued support and for actively reporting issues! We’ve received several reports about the skill book for "Adventurer - Ira" not being clickable. Since this issue may significantly impact gameplay, we’ve released a small update in an effort to address it. [/p][p]While our team is still investigating and cannot yet pinpoint the exact cause, this update includes additional logic checks to help resolve potential abnormalities. If you’re experiencing this issue, please make sure to update the game to the latest version and restart the game or Steam. [/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this has caused. We’ll continue monitoring the situation and work toward a complete fix. Thank you again for your patience and support! 🙇‍♂️ [/p][p][/p][p][b]Update Notes - 06/20/2025 [/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Improve the skill unlock logic after the womb tattoo is unlocked.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]FPS lock added [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Various balance and UI optimizations for the demo version[/b][/p][/*][/list]
